name: Elaichi API
description: Control-plane HTTP API for Elaichi — the MCP control plane for SaaS teams. Every operation here is callable with an organization API token (or, on the MCP and OAuth surfaces, per the relevant protocol). Endpoints reached only by the Elaichi web app with a session cookie, by a browser redirect, by an inbound webhook, or by platform staff are deliberately not documented.
